title: Lập trình .Net
duration: 3 tín chỉ (45 giờ tín chỉ; 50 phút/giờ)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply .Net programming concepts, develop applications on Windows, and manage database operations.
Analyze, design, and implement database functions, including data retrieval, updating, and reporting.
Develop logical thinking and problem-solving skills to solve specific programming tasks.
Work independently and collaboratively in a team, understanding responsibilities and professional ethics.
Demonstrate the ability to self-study and seek resources to complete assignments and projects.
